description: Stop an automatic backup schedule on a Proxmox VPS. Get the schedule_id from impreza_vps_list_backup_schedules. This stops FUTURE backups; the ones already taken stay and are still listed by impreza_vps_list_backups. Tell the customer that after this nothing is backing the machine up automatically.
name: impreza_vps_delete_backup_schedule
title: Delete VPS backup schedule
